vision.heading: Gather Together.
vision.paragraph: Discover a small-town setting designed to connect nature and community like never before. A place where living simply and beautifully is inevitable. Where new homes are built with an appreciation for the land and your fellow neighbors. Where local shops are right around the corner and the shopkeeper knows you by name. And where spaces are created for family and friends to gather, learn and grow. Welcome to Mulberry Grove.

community.heading: Peace of Place.
community.paragraph: Just north of Columbus, GA and encompassing over 1,000 acres, Mulberry Grove introduces a thoughtfully planned community that is worlds away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Nestled among 30 acres of lakes and 138 acres of greenway, our community will offer a neighborhood environment complete with beautiful residences, convenient retail, community spaces and abundant greenspace. Paths and trails for hiking and biking. Lakes and parks for relaxation and recreation. All of it perfectly suited to its natural surroundings, allowing for a slower pace and a true sense of place.

location.heading: Idyllically Located.
location.paragraph: At home in Harris County, Mulberry Grove’s location is the perfect mix of laid-back living and modern conveniences. Surrounded by local farms and hamlets, our community sits right off Highway 185 with a dedicated exit, making access to nearby cities and employment centers a breeze. A quick 20 minutes to the south, Columbus offers an abundance of great local shopping and dining options. And with a strong public school system in Harris County, nearby universities and an abundance of recreational amenities, the quality of life makes for the perfect base.

residential.heading: Come Home.
residential.paragraph: From residences to own to apartments for lease, Mulberry Grove is creating dwelling places designed with your unique needs in mind. With classic, traditional and craftsman-style architecture, each new home provides a warm and welcoming lifestyle that connects to the surrounding community. Whether you’re a young family searching for a first home or an empty nester looking for a simpler way of life, look no further than Mulberry Grove.

stoneMartin.heading: Stone Martin Builders
stoneMartin.paragraph: Proudly delivering exquisite homes across the southeast. Your one-of-a-kind design is nestled into a neighborhood with stunning scenery, a functional layout and premier amenities. Celebrate life in a community that fits your unique style of living. Discover your ideal home today.

greystone.heading: Greystone Properties
greystone.paragraph: Our mission is to provide superior apartment communities where living is a pleasure. Anticipating and exceeding your expectations, all of our communities are convenient to all of the attractions, shopping, restaurants, great schools and much more. Experience the Greystone Properties difference.

retail.heading: Experiences Every Day.
retail.paragraph: Mulberry Grove is a master planned community that sits ready to serve its residents by providing development opportunities for a mix of local, regional and national brands. By offering a wide range of services and amenities all within walking distance, Mulberry Grove is ready to make life easier and just a little bit sweeter.

privacyParagraphs: Your privacy is important to us. It is Mulberry Grove’s policy to respect your privacy regarding any information we may collect from you across our website, http://experiencemulberrygrove.com, and other sites we own and operate.

We only ask for personal information when we truly need it to provide a service to you. We collect it by fair and lawful means, with your knowledge and consent. We also let you know why we’re collecting it and how it will be used.

We only retain collected information for as long as necessary to provide you with your requested service. What data we store, we’ll protect within commercially acceptable means to prevent loss and theft, as well as unauthorized access, disclosure, copying, use or modification.
We don’t share any personally identifying information publicly or with third-parties, except when required to by law.

Our website may link to external sites that are not operated by us. Please be aware that we have no control over the content and practices of these sites, and cannot accept responsibility or liability for their respective privacy policies.
You are free to refuse our request for your personal information, with the understanding that we may be unable to provide you with some of your desired services.

Your continued use of our website will be regarded as acceptance of our practices around privacy and personal information. If you have any questions about how we handle user data and personal information, feel free to contact us.
This policy is effective as of 27 May 2020.
